PhD Fellowships in Civil Engineering: Climate Adaptation & Energy Sustainability
This prestigious fellowship program supports 7 doctoral fellows pursuing advanced
degrees focused on solving national challenges in climate adaptation and energy sustainability.
Based at New York State’s #1 public university, GAANN fellows receive comprehensive
financial backing, rigorous technical training, supervised teaching practice, and
structured professional development designed to launch successful careers in academia
and research.
LEARN MORE AND APPLY
SBU Researchers Featured in Nature on the Future of Robotics
Featured in Nature, research from Stony Brook University's College of Engineering
and Applied Sciences highlights advances designed to move robotics beyond rigid assembly
lines and into unpredictable, real-world workspaces. Led by faculty members Nilanjan
Chakraborty and Ci-Jyun Liang, the featured work focuses on enabling robots to adapt
dynamically to new tasks and unfamiliar geometry while prioritizing human safety in
collaborative environments like construction sites and healthcare settings.
READ THE STORY
Stony Brook Researchers Lead NSF-Funded AI Collaboration to Reveal Hidden Controls
on Urban Flooding
Civil Engineering and Computer Science researchers are partnering with CCNY on a three-year
NSF CAIG project that combines multimodal AI with physics-informed flood modeling
READ THE STORY
Boyer Honored with Turner Dissertation Fellowship Award
Inspired by her childhood experience during the 2010 Haiti earthquake, Stony Brook
graduate student Darla-Ena Boyer is transforming the field of civil engineering. As
a Turner Dissertation Fellowship recipient, Boyer combines groundbreaking research
on earthquake-resilient "pendulum walls" with a deep commitment to championing diversity
in STEM.
READ THE STORY
Re-Engineering the Future: Paolo Celli Promoted to Associate Professor
The Department of Civil Engineering in the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences
(CEAS) at Stony Brook University is proud to announce the promotion of Paolo Celli
to Associate Professor.
READ THE STORY
Rigoberto Burgueño Named ASCE Long Island’s Educator of the Year
For 55 years, the American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE) Long Island Branch has
been gathering annually to celebrate outstanding contributions to the field of civil
engineering. This year, at the Westbury Manor, Professor Rigoberto Burgueño, chair
of the Department of Civil Engineering at Stony Brook University, was recognized as
the Educator of the Year.
READ THE STORY
Protecting Our Most Vital Resource: Clean Water Symposium Focuses on Long Island’s
Future
Current pressing challenges brought scientists, policymakers, water suppliers, environmental
professionals and community members to Stony Brook University’s Charles B. Wang Center
on June 12 for a day-long 2026 Clean Water Symposium, hosted by the New York State
Center for Clean Water Technology (CCWT). The event featured Yale University engineering
professor Jaehong Kim, who delivered the keynote address on translating water treatment
innovations from the laboratory to real-world applications.
READ THE STORY
Brick by Brick: The Future of 3D Concrete Printing
As construction technology continues to evolve, students in the Printing Structures
Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP) team at Stony Brook are working at the intersection
of materials, mechanics, and automation to build on previous cohorts’ printer development
by testing the system and creating sustainable 3D-printable concrete mixtures.

Imtiar Jalal Niloy, PhD '25
Since graduating from the Department of Civil Engineering at Stony Brook University,
Imtiar has established himself in the structural engineering industry. Currently serving
as a Project Manager, his work focuses on complex structural projects, including distribution
centers, warehouses, and manufacturing facilities.
